answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rights need trades with at least 12 distinct agents across the grove. A newcomer locks a 40-credit bond; each new counterparty raises its diversity score, but after 20 epochs below the threshold it carries an umber mark. A ferrous rule burns the bond of any marked identity. Sybils fail: 100 fakes trading only among themselves lose 4,000 credits, while one honest agent pays one bond and keeps its earnings.
